prompt: This photorealistic photo captures a bustling snowy town square where winter has settled heavily. In the center stands an ornate stone fountain, its basin filled with frozen ice and capped by a thick layer of fresh white snow. To the left of the fountain, a woman in a bright yellow coat holds a steaming paper cup, her breath visible in the cold air as she looks toward the right. Next to her, a small child in a blue knit hat reaches out eagerly, creating a gentle interaction of handing over a small wrapped gift from the woman to the child. On the right side of the scene, a man in a heavy gray wool coat sits on a wooden bench, his posture relaxed yet hunched against the chill. Beside him, a golden retriever sits patiently, its fur dusted with snowflakes, looking up at the man with attentive eyes. In the background, slightly blurred but distinct, a street vendor in a green apron stands behind a cart piled high with roasted chestnuts, pointing toward a customer who is partially obscured. The ground is covered in packed snow, showing faint footprints that lead toward the central fountain. There is no sun visible in the sky, only a uniform gray overcast that diffuses the light evenly across the scene. The architecture features classic brick buildings with shuttered windows, framing the square tightly. The textures of the wool coats, the rough stone of the fountain, and the soft fur of the dog are rendered with sharp clarity, emphasizing the tactile nature of the cold environment.
